in_sanskrit.name: Ajhar
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Ajit's victory
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ajhar एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ajah' which means 'not born'. The name Ajhar is formed by prefixing the syllable 'Aj' to the root 'Har'. 'Aj' is derived from 'Ajit', a name of Lord Vishnu. 'Har' is derived from 'Hari', a name of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing victory. Thus, Ajhar signifies the victory of Lord Vishnu or Lord Ajit.
